purpose: Avoid reimplementing widely validated software. Reuse validated external packages with license and provenance checks, and isolate Plenum-specific research logic.

software.name: LangGraph
software.notes: Retain existing orchestration; do not rebuild graph execution engine.

software.name: Inspect AI
software.notes: Pinned Inspect model evaluation framework worked and official independent scorers evaluated real locally inferred Qwen answers, raw logs archived. Tool smoke, model scoring, and evaluation configuration are different verified boundaries. No model promotion.
software.real_model_result: Qwen3-0.6B non-thinking 17/24 across official ARC Easy and Challenge; original thinking-on run 0/24 due invalid output format. Not AGI or model learning.

software.name: OpenHands Software Agent SDK
software.notes: OpenHands SDK 1.60.1 + openhands-tools 1.60.1: real FileEditorExecutor created and edited a static public toy program and refused unauthorized write in an ephemeral temporary workspace; real tool behavior verified, no LLM, no autonomous agent or novel code generated. PR #25 merged.

software.name: PaperQA2
software.notes: Actual pinned PaperQA2 local sparse embeddings indexed 2 public NOAA/battery notes and retrieved only 1/2 intended top-1 sources, no model or paid API calls. Results are insufficient for reliable research QA; future tests must use newly preregistered documents.

software.name: Inspect Evals HumanEval
software.notes: Original HumanEval Python test grader executes model-generated functions only inside sandbox; initial tiny sample shows code capability, not autonomous agents or AGI. Archive negative/positive original official results before claims.

software.name: Inspect ReAct / OpenHands / mini-SWE-agent reuse decision
software.prerequisites: verified Docker isolation, source-approved model backend and compute ceiling, independent test-based task scoring
software.notes: Do not build new planning/agent loop or claim self-improvement. Prefer existing Inspect react(), OpenHands Software Agent SDK, SWE-bench Verified and PaperBench. A completed multistep task is needed, not library import.

software.notes: Official released training code and checkpoints. Do not clone/retrain multiple giant models or claim latent prediction is proven causality.
